title: A tested foundation and an earlier plan

captions.energy: Releasing a view from false foundations
captions.emotions: Letting an earlier shared image end

meaning: Testing a foundation can make your shared view more accurate even when releasing an earlier image of an intention feels difficult.
text: An earlier shared image can end after one unnoticed condition becomes clear. The Lovers in the physical position of Ajna suggest comparing personal ideas freely. The Tower in energy supports releasing a view from a false foundation. Death in emotions experiences farewell to an earlier image. Losing what seemed already understood may feel sad.

Suppose you discuss a small creative undertaking. One person finds it manageable, the other too committing. Conversation reveals different ideas about frequency: one imagined a single trial, the other a regular activity. **An honest foundation lets an image end when it fails to include actual expectations.** An assumption about an identical plan stops working. The attractive shared picture may feel sad to lose while interest in the subject remains material. Trying something becomes distinguishable from continuing regularly. Your view gains accuracy while each person retains time to absorb it without immediately enjoying clarification.

The risk is treating sadness as proof that the whole discussion was empty. One inaccurate element devalues other real wishes. Testing foundations can give it a precise limit. Farewell to an earlier picture can continue beside that question. Your view preserves meaning when an unconfirmed image can end without deciding the value of both people’s entire experience.
